parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/shared/base.controller.ts is a presentation-layer base class. Its only responsibility is getUserIdFromToken: it reads the HTTP Authorization header, takes the bearer token, verifies it and returns the user id. Getting the caller's identity from request credentials is a transport and request-handling job, the same work this layer model puts in presentation through guards (**/*.guard.ts, src/common/guards/**). The file has no persistence, no domain or business rules and no application orchestration. One could argue that JWT verification belongs in infrastructure, since passport strategies are mapped there. But checking credentials at the request boundary is normal presentation work and does not count as a different layer's responsibility under this rubric. No ADR prose was given. Importing config and jsonwebtoken is a dependency-direction question, which is out of scope here.
